extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record from local XML/PDF/OA supplementary material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DRS-DA2N and DRS-DA2NEQ adopt alpha-helical structure in negatively charged membrane-mimicking environments; DRS-DA2N was further resolved by NMR in SDS micelles.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural evidence supports membrane-associated conformation, not a receptor-specific target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DRS-DA2N causes immune-cell death with membrane integrity loss rather than preserving membrane integrity during apoptosis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence is cellular membrane disruption; no receptor-mediated immune signaling target is established.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DRS-DA2 peptides permeabilize bacterial membranes, depolarize the cytoplasmic membrane, and leak POPE/POPG LUVs.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DRS-DA2N; DRS-DA2NEQ in E. coli ML35p and LUV models
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is membrane perturbation; exact figure-derived kinetic values were not converted into tabular values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Local intraperitoneal DRS-DA2N treatment reduces inflammatory-cell recruitment in a thioglycolate peritonitis model without systemic blood/bone-marrow depletion.
direct_assay_types: flow cytometry cell counts in peritoneal cavity, blood, and bone marrow
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is in vivo activity context, not a molecular receptor mechanism.
